results.title: Abacum raises $60m Series B
results.content:
New York/London/Barcelona, 11th June 2025 - Abacum, the business planning software company founded by Julio Martínez and Jorge Lluch, today announces that it has raised a $60m Series B round led by San Francisco-headquartered Scale Venture Partners.

There was also strong participation in the round from global VC fund Cathay Innovation, with existing investors Y Combinator, Creandum, Kfund, and Atomico all doubling down on their backing for the “Office of the CFO” technology company. [...] /

Gone are the days when finance teams spent countless hours manually updating spreadsheets and running scenarios – today's most strategic finance leaders are leveraging artificial intelligence to deliver faster, more accurate insights.
